Card Q&A.a: Yes, the [When Evolving] effect activates separately for each yellow Tamer you suspend, and you get to choose the target for each effect.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to suspend 2 or more yellow Tamers. Can I choose 2 or more of my opponent's Digimon and give all of them -4000 DP?

Card Q&A.a: No, they're treated as activating at the same timing.
Card Q&A.q: I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect two or more times. Are they treated as activating at separate timings?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your yellow Tamers. For each Tamer you suspend this way, activate the following effect:
・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn.
[Your Turn] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for each Tamer you have in play.
